claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mepyramine is a first-generation antihistamine that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, with any antiproliferative effect likely reflecting weak, non-selective cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than H1-receptor-mediated killing.
